scope: Fixed original Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, one-week extension, user-reported removal of the old GPU-hour cap; finite job bounds and the historical experiment remain intact.

facts_reported_by_parent_from_completed_: All 83029 prepared source outputs begin with a literal <think> tag and have one balanced tag pair.
The old advanced 15000 originals already had complete supervised EOS and boxed answers, lower repetition and lower English branching-keyword density than random.
The advanced model nevertheless ended 7526 of 15552 benchmark samples at the length limit.
local_evidence.inference_not_established_cause: Another completeness/branching-only selector is unlikely to be a sufficient new mechanism. Teacher/student trajectory mismatch and harmful policy drift deserve direct causal tests. The audit does not prove either mechanism and does not establish a training-code bug.

primary_research.mechanism: Detached online target-probability-weighted CE plus forward KL from frozen starting model to the trainable model.
primary_research.relevance: A direct retention intervention compatible with unchanged original pairs and full-parameter SFT. It is distinct from post-hoc weight interpolation.
primary_research.caveats: Published math experiments use Qwen2.5-7B, different data and evaluation. Its own 30K math table has ASFT aggregate27.18 versus DFT27.66, so superiority is not universal. KL on teacher-forced states need not preserve behavior at student-visited generation states.
primary_research.cost_evidence: One reported LLaMA-7B configuration takes0.648h versus0.524h SFT, with substantially higher memory. This ratio is not a B200/Qwen3B runtime prediction.

primary_research.mechanism: Use frozen starting-model probabilities or cumulative probability mass to weight original target tokens, avoiding online self-reinforcing weights.
primary_research.relevance: A reproducible prior-support baseline for our proposed prior-weighted and KL-anchored synthesis.
primary_research.caveats: Prior support is not correctness. Raw probability can favor easy formatting/function tokens and suppress genuinely new knowledge. Published improvements are not directly comparable to our assignment protocol.
primary_research.cost_evidence: A single reference forward pass adds approximately1/(3E) FLOPs to E SFT epochs: about33% for one epoch,16.7% for two. Cached reference statistics can avoid a simultaneous reference model during later training.

primary_research.mechanism: Controlled experiments attribute much of RL retention to on-policy data rather than KL regularization or advantage estimation alone; approximately on-policy data can be useful.
primary_research.relevance: Motivates an independent own-trajectory data arm alongside anchored SFT, especially because every supplied original trace shares the same imported thinking style.
primary_research.caveats: A mechanism and transfer hypothesis, not evidence that our exact3B model will improve on every math/science benchmark.

primary_research.mechanism: Repeatedly sample current-model solutions, retain answer-correct responses within a length budget, and train with supervised learning.
primary_research.evidence: R1-Distill-Qwen1.5B: accuracy59.9 versus original59.0, Pass@N73.6 versus73.5, mean length2186 versus10178. Main models are R1-distill1.5B and7B, not our nonreasoning Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct.
primary_research.cost_evidence: Authors report about30% of their ThinkPrune baseline wall time to converge, but this does not provide an absolute B200 budget for us.
primary_research.caveats: Primarily an efficiency result with small accuracy changes. Own-trajectory SFT can reshape existing success probability without adding missing capabilities. A one-shot rejection-sampling pilot is an approximately-on-policy adaptation, not a reproduction of their iterative algorithm.

primary_research.mechanism: Small students can benefit more from compatible shorter traces and a mixture of reasoning styles than from only long strong-teacher traces.
primary_research.exact_model_evidence: For Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, the reported five-task aggregate is40.3 with long traces,43.4 with short traces and45.9 with mixed distillation.
primary_research.caveats: Different training data and decoding. Shortening alone is not a correctness guarantee, and arbitrary deletion/truncation can remove necessary reasoning. A regenerated or rewritten trace must remain separately identified from an original assignment pair.

primary_research.evidence: Its Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct six-math-task Pass@1 aggregate is32.4 for APMPO versus29.4 GRPO and25.1 original in that paper.
primary_research.caveats: These are author-reported different-protocol results, not our eight-task macro. That paper lists12000 MATH training examples and674 Olympiad examples; exact bytes/splits must be audited before borrowing data or scores. No GPQA preservation result establishes an all-benchmark benefit. Absolute training GPU-hours were not established in this review. Start with auditable GRPO before adding adaptive objectives.

primary_research.evidence: Across studied settings, RLVR often improves small-k accuracy while the original model covers more solutions at sufficiently large k; distillation can add teacher reasoning patterns.
primary_research.caveats: This is empirical evidence about the studied algorithms and budgets, not an impossibility theorem for every RL setup. It directly motivates measuring both pass@1 and pass@8 rather than choosing only a convenient metric.

recommended_priority.reason: Preserves the clean15K original-pair assignment experiment and uses already prepared objective implementations. Test true base compatibility and retention, not completeness/branch filtering alone.
causal_controls: Same original model revision, tokenizer, prompts, optimizer precision, response masks and per-example reduction.
Cross eligible-random and proposed coverage/base-compatible selection with ordinaryCE and the frozen-base anchored objective on matched data.
Keep ASFT as a published baseline; identify frozen-prior-weighted-plus-KL as an experimental synthesis with no novelty claim.
Track effective gradient weights, comparable update magnitude, EOS supervision, base KL, generation stopping and labeled math/science accuracy.
Use predefined development and independent confirmation; never choose the winning objective from assignment benchmark results.

recommended_priority.arm: Separately labeled answer-checked concise approximately-on-policy SFT
recommended_priority.reason: Directly changes the teacher/student prefix distribution that the native audit found common to all original traces; avoids the implementation burden of a new RL stack.
causal_controls: Use the same independently labeled, decontaminated training questions for compared response policies; separate every training question from development/confirmation.
Compare source/expert traces with sampled answer-correct student traces on the common-question intersection. Do not compare different easy/hard question populations as if only trace style changed.
If selecting the shortest correct trace, include a random-correct trace control where feasible to isolate conciseness from correctness rejection sampling.
Match example exposure and record actual target-token exposure; shortened data changes both distribution and token budget.
Keep generated targets, raw rollouts, model revision, question IDs, answers, grader decisions and selection probabilities separate from the unchanged original15K exports.

Call outputs answer-checked, not logically verified reasoning: matching the final answer cannot certify every intermediate step. AceReason boxed-answer agreement alone is weaker than independent ground-truth verification.

recommended_priority.reason: Worth a bounded smoke test if the preceding rollout inventory produces nontrivial mixtures of successful and unsuccessful attempts and the main SFT pipeline remains on schedule.
causal_controls: Use exact original3B initialization or a single prespecified SFT initialization; do not silently compare different initial models.
Use trustworthy answer rewards with native grader oracles and record all-zero/all-one group rates; group-relative gradients vanish without reward variation.
Compare GRPO with answer-checked SFT using the same question pool, rollout distribution and approximately matched generated-token budget; include rollout and optimizer costs.
Freeze reward, length/truncation policy, KL direction/coefficient, advantage normalization, clipping and sampling before the RL pilot.

Audit reward exploitation, output diversity and independent science retention. Do not introduce Prolog tools, majority voting or inference-time selection into the unchanged assignment benchmark protocol.

prerequisites: Native CPU tests and zero-update serialization/config checks pass.
Seal exact data IDs, independently sourced answers, exclusions, licenses and train/development/confirmation partitions.
Write exact pilot acceptance/ranking and failure-stop rules before generation; preserve the old source screens as previously viewed data.
Inspect the separate extension ledger and scheduler for duplicates; keep old plans/ledgers/checkpoints unchanged.

first_rollout_inventory.proposed_allocation_ceiling: One B200 for at most2hours; an operational reservation, not a measured runtime prediction.
record: Per-question correctness, native stopping/EOS, boxed-answer extraction, output length and repetition.
Questions with zero, partial or complete success across eight samples.
Number and topic/difficulty distribution of questions retaining at least one completed answer-correct trajectory under the predefined length budget.
All raw output identities and failed/incomplete work; never treat a partial inventory as a completed experiment.

matched_small_sft_pilot.bounded_scope: At most one small matched pilot for the anchored original-pair branch and one separately identified generated-trace branch after frozen admission. Reserve at most4additional GPU-hours initially, then recalibrate from measured native throughput.
gate_dimensions_to_freeze: Independent labeled math accuracy and science noninferiority, with both pass@1 and pass@8.
Native stopping, length-limit finishes, repetition and supervised termination-token counts.
No selection from public benchmark outcomes; no claim based solely on lower teacher-forced loss or shorter responses.

optional_grpo_smoke_test.initial_ceiling: At most2 B200 GPU-hours for environment, reward, rollout/update and provenance smoke testing; no automatic multi-day continuation.
optional_grpo_smoke_test.continuation_condition: Only after a frozen plan, native tests, usable mixed-reward groups and source-only learning/retention evidence; exact full training reservation requires its own review and admission.

proposed_bounded_next_pilot_not_admitted.main_feasibility_constraint: Unlimited user GPU-hours do not remove the one-week wall-clock, queue, implementation, data-verification or final-evaluation constraints. Keep a bounded final-candidate policy and explicit final benchmark/publication reserves.

claim_limits: No method here has demonstrated a win on all eight assignment benchmarks for this exact3B model and frozen protocol.
R1-distill, specialized math-base and general-instruct checkpoints are different models; their scores cannot replace our original-model comparison.
Our previously viewed assignment test scores make later benchmark comparisons exploratory; new independent confirmation improves selection discipline but cannot erase prior exposure.
New concise/distilled or RL arms are additional experiments and must not be relabeled as training on the original unmodified15K response pairs.
work_performed_by_this_review: Primary-source browsing, small source/metadata reads and creation of this planning JSON only. No model/data workload, tests, scheduler submission, inference or publication was performed.
